discription: A pulse wave synthesizer with an ADSR envelope and controllable pulse width modulation (PWM). The pulse width can be static or modulated by an LFO.
code: { arg out=0, freq=440, amp=0.1, gate=1, width=0.5, pwModDepth=0, pwModFreq=0;var sig;var env = EnvGen.ar(Env.adsr(0.01, 0.1, 0.8, 1.0, curve: -4),gate: gate,doneAction: 2);var pwModSignal = LFSaw.kr(pwModFreq).range(-1, 1);var actualWidth = (width + (pwModSignal * pwModDepth)).clip(0.01, 0.99);sig = Pulse.ar(freq, actualWidth) * amp * env;Out.ar(out, sig ! 2);}
